content:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — seeing a sustained drop in prefix cache hit stability across a subset of tenants after the kernel-selector roll last Wed. Putting together a short explainer + dashboard sketch. Snapshot: overall hit-rate down ~6%, tokens_saved down ~12k/min for top-10 tenants.

Kevin Zhang: Do we have per-model & per-route breakdown yet? could be the new kernels mapping to model variants (eg fast-attn-v2).

Priyanka Rao: We also changed batching: lowered max_batch_latency to 10ms for low-latency route 'chat-stream'. That can change coalescing patterns and key grouping.

Samir Patel: Quick profiler notes: observed higher KV lookup variance on fast-attn-v2 for seq_len > 512, and more key churn. I pulled a raw rollup we can use in the dashboard:

```
SELECT
  model, route, customer_id, count(*) as calls,
  sum(tokens_saved) as tokens_saved,
  approx_percentile(kv_lookup_ms, 50) as kv_median_ms,
  avg(CASE WHEN hit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hit_rate
FROM prefix_cache.events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY model, route, customer_id
ORDER BY tokens_saved DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

ingest-bot: ALERT: prefix_cache_hit_rate_drop detected for route 'chat-stream' at 2026-03-17T14:21:12Z — delta -5.8% over rolling 1h window.

Kevin Zhang: Can we add a churn metric: fraction of cache keys seen < 2 times in a 1h window (key_stability). Also want a heatmap: model x route hit-rate delta (pre-roll vs post-roll).

Maria Lopez: Proposed panels for the dashboard: 1) heatmap: model vs route hit-rate delta (24h pre vs 24h post), 2) token-saved waterfall by customer, 3) key_stability timeseries (fraction low-frequency keys), 4) kv_lookup_latency distribution by kernel & seq_len bucket, 5) top churning keys sample (links to trace ids).

Priyanka Rao: For experiments: I can flip batching heuristic back to previous value for a small canary (we have flagging per-tenant). That isolates batching from kernel selection. Suggest 48h canary + daily snapshot.

Samir Patel: To fetch trace for a sample span, run:

```
./profiler fetch --trace-id=ab12cd34 --format=json | jq '.events[] | {ts, span, kv_lookup_ms}'
```

Samir Patel: Also looking at kernel routing logs, there's a spike in route_splits for fast-attn-v2 around the same time as the roll — might be a routing rule mismatch.

Kevin Zhang: Actionable slices to add to dashboard: per-customer token-saved delta, per-model hit-rate delta, key_stability percentile (p50/p90), kv_lookup_ms p50/p95, and list of kernels with >3% hit-rate regression.

Maria Lopez: Proposed next steps: 1) Priyanka -> deploy batching revert flag for 5 tenants (canary) by EOD, 2) Samir -> attach sample traces for top 10 affected customers and push to the dashboard, 3) Kevin -> create heatmap & churn panels and wire alerts for kernel-correlated regressions, owner: Kevin, ETA 24h, 4) I'll prepare a rollback playbook if canary shows major token-savings loss.

Priyanka Rao: I set the canary flag on tenant ids [acct-112, acct-877, acct-999] and scheduled a metric snapshot at +6h, +24h. Will post results. :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: METRIC_SNAPSHOT saved: prefix_cache_24h_rollup: snapshot_id=ss-20260317-1790, link=https://metrics/redwood/snapshots/ss-20260317-1790

Maria Lopez: Great — once heatmap is up we can attribute regressions to either kernel or batching. If both correlate, we'll prioritize revert that minimizes token loss while preserving latency SLOs.

Kevin Zhang: I'll ping when the panels are live. If anyone needs query tweaks, drop examples here and I can iterate.

Maria Lopez: Thanks all — will sync after 24h canary.
